blocks.text: SM Supermalls named among the world’s 100 best; SM Mall of Asia, SM Megamall and SM Seaside City Cebu make WorldWorthy’s 100 Best Shopping Malls 2026, accounting for three of the country’s five entries SM Supermalls has three malls on WorldWorthy’s 100 Best Shopping Malls 2026 list, more than any other mall operator in the Philippines. SM Mall of Asia leads the country’s entries at No. 29 worldwide and is ranked No. 1 in the Philippines, followed by SM Megamall at No. 41 and SM Seaside City Cebu at No. 94.
